summary: The Cheesecake Factory filed an 8-K to report Q1 fiscal 2026 financial results, post an investor presentation, and declare a quarterly cash dividend of $0.30 per share paid on May 26, 2026 to holders of record May 13, 2026. This is a routine earnings release and dividend declaration without any terms indicating a special situation. The board's dividend decision is ordinary. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other structured event is present. The filing is purely operational and financial in nature. What to watch: continued dividend policy and earnings trends.
